brief_rationale: Dr correctly identified the medication execution hazard (preoperative IV antibiotics/skin tests are not discharge medications), screened current red-flag symptoms, secured a concrete post-ASD follow-up plan, and obtained patient teach-back. However, RC3 requires asking for or using workspace records to confirm discharge summary, medication list, CT report wording, and post-procedure instructions; the workspace queries returned 0 records and neither the discharge medication list nor the complete CT report were confirmed through patient-provided documents or a further directed evidence gap request, leaving this critical information gap unaddressed. This minor omission caps the grade at 2 (borderline). No high-order point was fully completed because the model did not actively verify the exact CT wording (HO3) nor build a durable sorting rule from the screenshot/order structure (HO2), and HO1/HO4 were not triggered or completed.
